summary: Tested Mausam onboarding, all persona modules, persistence, hero data, customization modal, dark mode, map layers, forecasts, alerts, saved locations, desktop rendering, and mobile menu. Core dashboard flows render and switch correctly. Backend status persistence also passes. A real 390px horizontal overflow remains, and several navigation/control buttons have no action handlers.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px viewport document.scrollWidth is 520px; persona buttons extend beyond the viewport. The strip is intended to scroll, but it creates page-level horizontal overflow.

integration_issues.issue: Home, Forecast, Map, Alerts, Saved Places, location selector, notification, profile, and View all alerts controls render but have no navigation, modal, or state action handlers.
Customization switches can be changed and Save closes the modal, but saved switch values do not hide/reorder any dashboard modules.

action_items: Constrain the persona switcher overflow so only the strip scrolls and document width stays at the mobile viewport.
Wire primary nav and header controls to their intended destinations or panels.
Persist customization selections and apply them to module visibility/order if customization is in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js contains a mock dashboard with no frontend API integration, which is acceptable for the selected mock-data choice but should remain clearly replaceable.
Several controls are visually interactive but have no onClick behavior, so the stated highly interactive homepage is incomplete beyond the tested dashboard state changes.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_mausam_review status record through POST /api/status for persistence verification; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All eight persona switches, onboarding continue, persona localStorage persistence, hero, customize open/save, dark mode, map layers, forecast/alert/saved content, and mobile menu were exercised. Recheck mobile overflow and wire-up of inert navigation/header controls after fixes. All weather and personalization content is MOCKED local data; no external weather integration was tested.
rca of the issue: The mobile overflow is caused by the persona switcher using overflow-x:auto while its flex children remain wider than the viewport and the containing layout does not fully clip the strip; measured scrollWidth was 520px at a 390px viewport. Inert controls are directly visible in App.js as buttons without onClick/navigation behavior. Customization closes the modal only and does not retain or consume checkbox state.
